test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Transform the following sentence into active voice.

The roads and bridges that connect many important cities in India have been renovated or rebuilt with great alacrity.

options.text: They have renovated or rebuilt the roads and bridges with great alacrity that connect many important cities.
They have renovated or rebuilt the roads and bridges that connect many important cities with great alacrity in India.
They have renovated or rebuilt the roads and bridges that connect many important cities in India with great alacrity.
They have renovated or rebuilt the roads and bridges that with great alacrity connect many important cities in India.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive to Active Voice Conversion:** In this transformation, the object of the passive sentence (which is the recipient of the action) becomes the object of the active sentence, and an agent (like "They") is introduced as the subject.
 
• The original sentence is in the **Present Perfect Tense**: *"have been renovated or rebuilt."*
 
• The active structure for Present Perfect is: **Subject + has/have + Past Participle + Object**.
 
• The phrase **"with great alacrity"** is an adverbial phrase that modifies the verbs "renovated or rebuilt." In the active voice, it should ideally follow the object it describes to maintain the flow of the original sentence.
 
• The entire noun phrase **"the roads and bridges that connect many important cities in India"** must stay together as the object to avoid "misplaced modifiers" (which happen when a descriptive phrase is too far from the word it describes).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They have renovated or rebuilt the roads and bridges that connect many important cities in India with great alacrity."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** This option separates "the roads and bridges" from the relative clause "that connect many important cities" by placing "with great alacrity" in between, which makes the sentence grammatically awkward.
 
• **Option 2:** This version places "in India" at the very end, potentially separating it from "cities," which changes the specific meaning of which cities are being discussed.
 
• **Option 4:** By placing "with great alacrity" inside the relative clause (*"...that with great alacrity connect..."*), it suggests the **connection** is fast/eager, rather than the **renovation**.
